goal: Build an actually trained own-weight 4-head AST-token proposer for quantified array invariant structure, independently prove original source Horn clauses, and compare strong classical native + human rule.

training.source_programs_teacher: Existing G3 human-derived, formally verified prefix/suffix/whole schemas; supervised labels from *already certified* relation roles only.
training.quantifier_program_language: 4 factorized categorical token heads: for each of two slots, interval choice OFF/PREFIX/SUFFIX/WHOLE and value role OFF/NEW/PREVIOUS/NEGATIVE_CONTROL. This grammar, quantifier syntax, semantic feature extraction and variable role are HUMAN-SPECIFIED.

external_first_candidate.independent_verifier: Z3 negated every unchanged CHC original assertion; no supplied expected-verdict shortcuts.
external_first_candidate.native_first: Run strong native Z3 15s per original or classify correctly as timeout/unknown. No claims of native impossibility.
external_first_candidate.once_only_first_gate: 2/2 correct model-generated original source proofs + strictly greater success than untrained weights on those originals; record strong classical human template comparable right.
